title: Beta MINI Account Registration payload
description: Semantic schema for mininet.beta/account/v1. The canonical Rust parser re-derives account_id from beta_epoch + signed owner DID + nonce; this schema is documentation/interchange, not a substitute for that check. Adapters must run tools/check_beta_payload.py; x-mininet keywords and did-mini format checks are mandatory. Signed-object Rust validation remains required.
